title: Approval of the Award of a five (5)-year Contract to Downstream Services Inc.: Covering sanitary sewer and storm drain cleaning and inspection services at Los Angeles International Airport and Van Nuy
text:
[CONSENT ITEMS FOR BOARD ACTION [Consent Items 1 - 10]]
RESOLUTION NO. - Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of the Award of a five (5)-year Contract to Downstream Services Inc.: Covering sanitary sewer and storm drain cleaning and inspection services at Los Angeles International Airport and Van Nuys Airport, for cost not to exceed $4,500,000 (Daniel Hughes)
summary: Five-year contract with Downstream Services Inc. for cleaning and inspecting sanitary sewers and storm drains at LAX and Van Nuys Airport, up to $4,500,000.
